title: Ledger triage & renewal quicklist
content:
Morning triage notes (quick, for my eyes)

Purpose: a compact running list to clear out small finance/legal tasks that keep popping up. Unpolished — meant to be actionable and dumped on the page.

TODAY (fast pass)
- [ ] ACME Labs invoice #2321 — status: paid? audit mismatch. Bank shows 2025-10-30 deposit but TTL shows 11/14. Action: ask AR to confirm remittance and PO. Email to AR (priya cc) with: invoice, PO# 78-12, payment trace id, ask for remittance advice. 
- [ ] Stripe payout discrepancy: March-02 batch missing $1,420. Run quick ledger search for tx id 913-zz. If not found, escalate to Samir.
- [ ] Renewal alert: Zendesk integration (team: Platform) auto-renews 2026-04-15. Confirm final headcount + seats; propose two-week notice. Add pricing ask: negotiate to keep +10% cap.
- [ ] Contract redline: Vendor SOW (vendor: GrayPeak) — review clause 5b (data retention) & clause 9 (indemnity cap). Quick redline notes below.

QUICK REDLINE NOTES (GrayPeak SOW)
- Clause 5b: delete last sentence about indefinite backups. Replace with: "retain backups for maximum 90 days unless otherwise agreed in writing." (reason: avoid long tail e-discovery costs).
- Clause 9: indemnity cap = lesser of $250k or 1x fees; ask legal if we can set 6 months revenue instead of 1x. Flag: product team might push back.
- Confidentiality: add explicit carve-out for aggregated telemetry used for model perf research.

INVOICE SNAPSHOT (mini table)
- 2025-12-02: Invoice 2487 — CloudInfra — $12,300 — due 2026-01-01 — status: reconciled
- 2026-01-10: Invoice 2551 — Consulting (Adelia) — $4,200 — due 2026-02-09 — ACTION: verify expense code (should be R&D)
- 2026-02-01: Invoice 2579 — Marketing ads — $2,750 — dispute partial (overcharged $250) — inbox thread with vendor sent 2026-02-10

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Do we have a standard clause library for vendor SOWs? (I recall a set in Confluence under legal-templates). If not, create a short checklist.
- If AR can't locate ACME payment by EOD, petition finance lead for wire trace. Priority: high because revenue recognition depends on date.
- For subscriptions: build a tiny spreadsheet (cols: product, owner, renewal date, seats, current rate, negotiable?) — one-pager for procurement.

COMMUNICATION SCRIPTS (copy/paste drafts)
- To AR (ACME): "Hi — quick check: we show invoice #2321 cleared on 2025-11-14 in TTL, whereas our bank shows a deposit on 2025-10-30. Can you confirm remittance and PO link? Attached: invoice PDF + bank trace. Thanks — Aisha."
- To Vendor (GrayPeak): "Attached is a marked SOW with a few requested clarifications (data retention and indemnity cap). Happy to sync 20 min if helpful. If you prefer tracked changes, let me know."

NEXT STEPS / SCHEDULE
- EOD today: send ACME + Stripe follow-ups.
- Tomorrow morning: quick call with Legal (Priya) to agree on SOW language and whether to propose 90-day retention.
- Friday: compile subscription one-pager and drop in #procurement slack.

RANDOM QUICK CALCS (for prioritization)
- ACME outstanding = $12,300 (high priority — affects month close)
- GrayPeak contract value = est $48k annually (negotiation worth 5–10% savings)

SNIPPETS / TODO (future)
- Consolidate small vendor SOW redlines into a 1-pager developers can use when engaging vendors.
- Schedule a 30-min monthly "micro-audit" with AR to sweep missed payouts.

PERSONAL NOTE: keep this doc lightweight — once items resolved, move final copies into Confluence/finance repo and clear this scratchpad.
